The inherited light-triggered sneeze reflex disorder supports neurologic as primary. Sneezing alone does not establish pulmonary damage, and the light trigger does not establish ocular disease.

Petrous bone osteomyelitis supports musculoskeletal and infectious_immune. Bone infection does not independently establish a blood or marrow disorder; adjacent otitis does not require an otologic label.
